attempts.sql: SELECT regexp_extract(file_id, '^(auto_ontology/server/[^/]+)/', 1) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND regexp_matches(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/[^/]+/.+') GROUP BY folder_path HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
explanation: Extracts the immediate subfolder under auto_ontology/server/ from each file path, keeping only files nested at least one level deeper, then sums line counts per subfolder and filters to those exceeding 1,000 lines.
sql: SELECT regexp_extract(file_id, '^(auto_ontology/server/[^/]+)/', 1) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM code.files WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND regexp_matches(file_id, '^auto_ontology/server/[^/]+/.+') GROUP BY folder_path HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC
